privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: How TradeCatch collects, uses, and protects information submitted through this website and the systems we manage.

sections.heading: Who this policy covers
sections.body: This policy applies to TradeCatch, operated by Ara Ghahramanyan from the Greater Montreal area, Quebec, Canada, with respect to personal information collected through this website and the systems we manage on behalf of contractor clients. It is written to reflect Quebec's private-sector privacy legislation (the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as amended by Law 25) and applicable federal privacy law (PIPEDA).

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, company, trade, email, phone number, city, and answers to qualification questions when you book an audit. We also collect basic technical and analytics data about how the website is used, gated behind the cookie consent described in our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis for collection
sections.body: We use your information to respond to your audit request, schedule and conduct calls, prepare proposals, and, if you become a client, to design and operate your revenue recovery system. Collection is based on your consent (for optional communications) and on what is necessary to take steps at your request before entering a service agreement. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: SMS and email communication consent
sections.body: Contacting you about your specific audit request (by phone, email, or text) is a necessary service communication, not optional marketing. It is covered by the required consent checkbox on our forms. Marketing emails (tips, offers, updates) are separate, optional, opt-in, and never pre-checked, consistent with Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL). Message and data rates may apply to SMS. We record the exact wording, source form, and timestamp of each consent given, and honour opt-out or unsubscribe requests without delay.

sections.heading: Data sharing and service providers
sections.body: We share information with service providers that support our operations under agreements requiring them to protect your data and use it only for the purpose we specify. As of this writing that includes: Resend (transactional email delivery), Google Analytics 4 (site analytics, only after cookie consent), Cloudflare Turnstile (bot-abuse prevention on our forms), Twilio (SMS/voice for missed-call recovery when enabled), and Vercel (website hosting). We do not share your information for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Cross-border data transfers
sections.body: Some service providers listed above may process or store data outside Quebec or Canada, including in the United States. Where this occurs, we require contractual protections comparable to Quebec law. Privacy impact assessments for out-of-Quebec providers are conducted before those providers are used for client personal information in a live engagement; this public site alone does not constitute completion of every PIA.

sections.heading: Data retention schedule
sections.body: Our target retention for audit-request and contact-form submissions is up to 24 months after your last interaction with us, unless you become a client (in which case client records are retained per our service agreement and applicable tax/accounting requirements) or you request earlier deletion. Automated purge jobs for that schedule are being rolled out; until then, deletion and access requests are handled manually via our privacy contact. Missed-call operational records, when a durable store is enabled, follow the same target unless a client agreement specifies otherwise. Analytics data is retained per Google Analytics' default retention settings.

sections.heading: Your privacy rights
sections.body: Under Quebec and Canadian privacy law you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, and may withdraw consent to non-essential processing at any time, by contacting our privacy contact below. We will respond within the timelines required by law.

sections.heading: How to reach us or file a complaint
sections.body: For any privacy question or request, contact our privacy contact at ara.ghahramanyan07@gmail.com. If you believe we have not resolved your concern, you may file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (CAI).

sections.heading: Security and incident reporting
sections.body: We apply technical and organizational safeguards (encryption in transit, access restrictions, security headers, and the controls described in our security practices) appropriate to the sensitivity of the information involved. In the event of a confidentiality incident presenting a risk of serious harm, we will notify affected individuals and the CAI as required by Law 25.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy as our practices or legal obligations change. Material changes will be reflected in the "last updated" date above.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.metaDescription: The terms governing the use of the TradeCatch website and the revenue recovery systems we design, install, and manage.

sections.heading: Services
sections.body: TradeCatch designs, installs, and manages automated communication workflows for contractor businesses. The live product module today is missed-call response with lead qualification and technician alerting. Quote follow-up and related modules are offered only when explicitly included in a written proposal after they ship. Services are scoped and priced individually following an audit and confirmed in that proposal.

sections.heading: Client responsibilities
sections.body: Clients are responsible for providing accurate business information, approving message content and escalation rules before launch, and ensuring that licensed staff handle diagnosis, pricing, and safety-related decisions.

sections.heading: Service limitations
sections.body: The system does not diagnose technical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, medical, or safety conditions, and does not guarantee any specific volume of leads, bookings, or revenue. Results depend on factors outside our control, including demand, pricing, and service quality.

sections.heading: Emergency handling
sections.body: The system escalates messages using rules the client approves in advance; it does not itself assess or respond to emergencies. Handling of urgent or safety-related situations remains the responsibility of the contractor and their qualified personnel at all times, and clients must maintain their own emergency-response process independent of this system.

sections.heading: Fees and payment
sections.body: Setup and monthly management fees are outlined in your proposal and invoiced according to the agreed schedule. Late payment may result in suspension of services.

sections.heading: Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: Either party may terminate the management agreement with written notice according to the term specified in your proposal. Setup fees are non-refundable once work has begun; unused prepaid management fees for the remainder of a notice period are not refunded except as required by applicable Quebec consumer-protection law.

sections.heading: Electronic acceptance
sections.body: Proposals, this agreement, and related documents may be accepted electronically (including by e-signature or by written confirmation such as email). Electronic acceptance has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature, consistent with Quebec's legal framework for information technology (An Act to establish a legal framework for information technology).

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: TradeCatch is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the system, including missed communications caused by third-party phone, SMS, or software providers.

sections.heading: Governing law

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.metaDescription: Which cookies this website uses, why, and how to manage your preferences.

sections.heading: What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and let us understand how visitors use the site. This site also uses similar browser storage (localStorage) to remember your cookie choice itself.

sections.heading: Cookies and storage we use
sections.body: Essential: a language-preference cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers whether you're browsing in French or English; none of our own session cookies are otherwise strictly required for core browsing, and your cookie-consent choice is saved in your browser's localStorage so we don't ask again every visit. Analytics: Google Analytics 4 sets cookies (such as _ga) to measure traffic and usage, and only loads after you accept analytics cookies below. Security: Cloudflare Turnstile may set short-lived, essential cookies while verifying that a form submission is not automated; these are not used for tracking. We do not use cookies for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Managing your cookie choice
sections.body: You can accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or open detailed preferences using the banner shown on your first visit. All three options are equally easy to choose. You can change your choice at any time using the "Manage cookies" link in the footer, or by changing your browser settings to block or delete cookies.

acceptableUsePolicy.title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUsePolicy.metaDescription: Rules for acceptable use of the TradeCatch website, forms, and related systems.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This policy sets out acceptable use of this website, its forms, and any system we operate on your behalf. It exists to keep the site and our systems safe, available, and usable for everyone.

sections.heading: Prohibited activity
sections.body: You may not use this website or its forms to: submit false, fraudulent, or malicious information; attempt to bypass security controls (including rate limits, bot-verification, or form validation); scrape, harvest, or bulk-extract content or contact data; upload or transmit malicious code; or use the site in a way that infringes another party's rights or violates applicable law.

sections.heading: Automated and bulk use
sections.body: Automated interaction with our forms or systems (bots, scripts, scrapers) is not permitted except for legitimate, publicly documented purposes (such as search-engine indexing of public pages) that respect our robots.txt directives.

sections.heading: Enforcement
sections.body: We may block, rate-limit, or refuse service to any user or system that violates this policy, and may report unlawful activity to the appropriate authorities.

accessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityStatement.metaDescription: Our accessibility target for this website, known limitations, and how to report an accessibility issue.

sections.heading: Our commitment
sections.body: We aim for this website to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA, including keyboard navigability, visible focus states, sufficient colour contrast, semantic heading structure, and support for reduced-motion preferences.

sections.heading: Known limitations
sections.body: This site is under active development. Some third-party embeds (such as the Cloudflare Turnstile widget or a future calendar-booking embed) are provided by external vendors and may not fully match our own accessibility standard. We review and address issues as they're identified.

sections.heading: Feedback and contact
sections.body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this site, please contact us at ara.ghahramanyan07@gmail.com describing the page and the issue. We will work to address genuine barriers in a reasonable timeframe.

cancellationRefundPolicy.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
cancellationRefundPolicy.metaDescription: How TradeCatch handles cancellations, notice periods, setup fees and refunds for Québec contractors.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.body: This policy covers TradeCatch setup fees and ongoing monthly management fees for contractor revenue-recovery systems. Specific notice periods and amounts are confirmed in your written proposal.

sections.heading: Monthly management
sections.body: Either party may end the management agreement with written notice according to the term in your proposal (typically 30 days). Service continues through the notice period unless both parties agree otherwise.

sections.heading: Setup fees
sections.body: Setup fees cover design, configuration, message writing, testing and launch. Once that work has begun, setup fees are non-refundable.

sections.heading: Unused prepaid management
sections.body: Unused prepaid management fees for the remainder of a notice period are not refunded, except where Québec consumer-protection law requires otherwise.

sections.heading: Founding launch guarantee
sections.body: If an agreed founding system is not live because of a delay on our side, your first management month is credited as described in your founding agreement.

sections.heading: How to cancel
sections.body: Send written notice to ara.ghahramanyan07@gmail.com (or the email on your proposal). We will confirm the end date and any final invoice in writing.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: If something in your proposal conflicts with this page, the signed proposal controls. Contact us before canceling if you want to adjust scope instead.

emergencyServiceDisclaimer.title: Emergency-Service Disclaimer
emergencyServiceDisclaimer.metaDescription: TradeCatch does not diagnose emergencies or replace your emergency-response process. Read how escalation works.

sections.heading: What TradeCatch does
sections.body: TradeCatch can text missed callers, collect details you approve, and alert contacts you designate using rules you approve before launch.

sections.heading: What TradeCatch does not do
sections.body: The system does not diagnose technical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, medical or safety conditions. It does not decide whether a situation is an emergency, give safety instructions you have not approved, or replace 911 / public emergency services.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
sections.body: Handling of urgent or safety-related situations remains the responsibility of the contractor and qualified personnel at all times. You must maintain your own emergency-response process independent of this system.

sections.heading: Approved escalation only
sections.body: Messages and escalations follow templates and routing rules you signed off on. Change those rules with us in writing before they go live.

sections.heading: Customer-facing clarity
sections.body: If your templates mention emergencies, they must make clear that life-threatening situations require calling local emergency services first.
